title: Apple-Cranberry Tart
description: A spiralizer makes it easy to thinly cut apples for this beautiful apple-cranberry tart recipe flavored with lemon, cinnamon, and dried cranberries.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar, or to taste

steps.text: Place cranberries in a small bowl; cover with boiling water. Soak until plump, about 15 minutes; drain.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.

Cut a deep vertical slice in both sides of each apple, being sure not to cut through to the core. Attach 1 apple to a spiralizer fitted with the straight-flat blade; cut into thin half-slices according to manufacturer's instructions. Repeat with remaining apple.
Combine cranberries, apple slices, lemon juice, and vanilla extract in a bowl; toss to coat.
Combine white sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in a bowl; stir into apple mixture.
Roll pie crust out on a floured work surface to a 10-inch round; transfer to the prepared baking sheet.
Spoon apple mixture into center of crust, leaving a 2-inch border. Lift up edges of crust; fold around apple mixture. Brush edges with egg white; sprinkle turbinado sugar over tart.
Bake in the preheated oven until apples are tender and crust is golden brown, 38 to 40 minutes. Transfer to a serving plate and slice.
